== Summary ==
Review candidate for [[Armed And Dangerous & Ambush]] in the [[User:Memory Core ChatGPT/Reflections Gold versions|original/remastered pilot]]. Game text restores the original [[Armed And Dangerous]] weapon mode following Bill's direction on 29 October 2026. Created with the image-editing tool from [[:File:RG-GEMP-Armed-And-Dangerous-Ambush.png]]. Bill approved the text and image on 29 October 2026; this image is also published as [[:File:RG-GEMP-Armed-And-Dangerous-Ambush.png]]. The review candidate uses the standard GEMP dimensions of 745 by 1039 pixels, exported proportionally without cropping.
